summary: Five games were played on Tuesday, and road teams won three of them. Quentin Grimes scored a night-high 47 points, including a tying 3-pointer late in regulation, as the Lakers beat Charlotte in overtime, and Minnesota edged Portland 106-105 on a layup in the final seconds. Utah scored a night-high 132 and beat the Clippers by 25, the night's widest margin, behind 40 points from Brice Sensabaugh.

games.headline: Knicks close on 9-0 run to win in Toronto
games.story: Toronto led 48-35 in the second quarter before New York scored 19 straight points to go ahead 54-48, and the Knicks led 54-50 at halftime. The Raptors took an 83-80 lead into the fourth, and the game was tied at 102 when the Knicks scored the last nine points, starting with 1:25 left. Jalen Brunson scored 31 points and made all seven of his free throws, and Karl-Anthony Towns had 16 points, 16 rebounds and eight assists as New York outrebounded Toronto 44-23. Ja'Kobe Walter made seven 3-pointers and scored 25 for the Raptors, who were without Kawhi Leonard.

games.headline: McDaniels layup in final seconds lifts Wolves
games.story: Minnesota led 29-17 after the first quarter, but Portland went ahead 60-52 with a 12-0 run early in the third, and the teams were tied 79-79 after three. The Trail Blazers led 105-104 until LaMelo Ball's steal set up Jaden McDaniels' layup with 2.6 seconds left, and Trey Lyles blocked Damian Lillard's drive on the next possession. Ayo Dosunmu scored 30 points with seven 3-pointers, and McDaniels finished with 22. Lillard had 25 points and Jrue Holiday 23 for Portland, while Minnesota was without Anthony Edwards.

games.headline: Pistons rally from 14 down to beat Spurs
games.story: San Antonio led 40-26 early in the second quarter, but Detroit won the quarter 29-21 and led 55-54 at halftime. A 10-0 run in the third turned a 66-63 deficit into a 73-66 lead, and the Pistons never trailed again. Cade Cunningham scored 27 points, Daniss Jenkins added 25, and Ausar Thompson had 14 points, 12 assists, nine rebounds and five steals. Victor Wembanyama had 25 points and 18 rebounds for the Spurs, who made 9 of 40 3-point attempts.

games.headline: Grimes scores 47 as Lakers rally past Hornets in OT
games.story: Charlotte led by as many as 18 late in the third quarter and was ahead 94-81 going into the fourth. Los Angeles won the fourth 30-17, and Quentin Grimes tied the game at 111 with a 3-pointer with 2.4 seconds left in regulation. Luka Dončić's jumper put the Lakers ahead for good at 115-114 in overtime, and Grimes finished with 47 points and 10 3-pointers while Dončić added 36 points, seven rebounds and seven assists. Brandon Miller scored 28 for the Hornets, and Naz Reid had 23 points and 11 rebounds.

games.headline: Sensabaugh scores 40 as Jazz rout Clippers
games.story: The Clippers closed the first half on a 13-0 run to lead 62-58 at halftime, and Utah held an 88-86 edge after three quarters. The Jazz then scored 16 straight points early in the fourth, turning a 97-93 lead into a 113-93 lead, and won the quarter 44-21. Brice Sensabaugh scored 40 points on 16-of-21 shooting with eight 3-pointers and 11 rebounds, and Keyonte George added 30 points and 11 assists. Brook Lopez scored 23 for Los Angeles, and Utah made 20 of its 38 3-point attempts.
